text:
anna: Spotting a recurrent pattern in last week's postmortem — cross-region LB retries spike after autoscale events, specifically TLS handshake stalls. Need concrete owners for fixes and short timelines.

devon: I can own a short-term kinetic mitigation: tighten handshake timeout to 3s and prefer same-region backends on initial attempt. Will run a 3% canary. ETA: 24h.

riley: I'll own telemetry, alerts, and CI test coverage for handshake/cipher regressions. Plan: add cipher breakdown to retry dashboard + replay failing handshakes. ETA: 4d.

anna: Sample edge log: 
```
2026-03-26T08:11:02Z edge us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 TLS handshake stall cipher=TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 retries=9 backend=lb-pool-b
```

devon: Creating task SRE-2510 for the canary change + rollback criteria. Canary script: `deploy --svc lb-router --canary 3% --force-probe`; probe: `curl /health?region=euw` 5s timeout.

ops-bot: Created task <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2510|SRE-2510> assigned to devon. Due: 2026-03-27 12:00 UTC.

riley: Telemetry query: `SELECT cipher, count(*) FROM lb_handshakes WHERE retries>2 AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY cipher`  adding dashboard tile and alert `lb.cross_region_tls.retries` threshold=baseline*4 over 10m.

devon: Canary started. Initial canary results: retries on canary 0.7% vs baseline 1.8%. Posting links to logs in SRE-2510.

anna: Long-term items: 1) CI handshake matrix during scale-ups (Riley) 2) routing sticky-state fix to avoid route re-eval during hot scale (platform team) 3) TLS profile harmonization across regions (security). Let's track those in the same epic.

riley: Filed SRE-2511 for telemetry + CI work, linking SRE-2510. ETA: 2026-03-30.

anna: Recap owners and ETAs: devon (SRE-2510) mitigation + canary 24h, riley (SRE-2511) telemetry/CI 4d, platform/security to pick up routing/TLS profile follow-ups. Recheck in 48h. :thumbsup:
